audience: Brazilian online sellers who take Pix payments and run Pix Automático subscriptions

useCases.title: Create a Pix charge and send the payment code
useCases.text: Create a one-time Pix charge for an order and copy the payment code to the buyer. The charge is paid only after the PagSafe webhook reports AUTHORIZED.

useCases.title: Check whether a payment has cleared
useCases.text: Read the current status of a transaction, such as PENDING or AUTHORIZED. Use it to check a payment or to recover a missed webhook.

useCases.title: Refund a transaction in full
useCases.text: Refund the full amount of an authorized transaction to the buyer. A refund cannot be undone, so check the transaction status first.

useCases.title: Start a recurring Pix Automático subscription
useCases.text: Create a recurring Pix Automático subscription and show its QR code or payment link to the buyer. The buyer authorizes it once.

useCases.title: Check or cancel a customer subscription
useCases.text: Read the status and next charge date of a subscription. Cancel it to stop further cycles; the buyer keeps access until the paid cycle ends.
